gnosh session rename

  Give a session a new title. The words after the ID are the title.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh session rename [flags] <id> <title...>

Flags
  --json
      Print JSON instead of text. (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
